title: Skagen Falster 3 Smartwatch Patch
symptom: The Skagen Falster 3 cannot be used as a collector. When the phone is out of range, the watch no longer receives updates, and no error messages appear on the watch.
evidence_quote: The watch faces work fine, i can see my readings and everything, but it will not work as a collector. as soon as my phone is out of range i no longer get updates.
